facts.statement: Fossil material of Ulughbegsaurus was discovered in the Bissekty Formation, Uzbekistan, during the 1980s.
facts.quote: The Ulughbegsaurus fossil material was discovered in the Bissekty Formation, Uzbekistan in the 1980s.

facts.statement: Tanaka and colleagues formally described the genus and species Ulughbegsaurus uzbekistanensis in 2021.
facts.quote: In 2021, Tanaka and colleagues described Ulughbegsaurus uzbekistanensis as a new genus and species of theropod dinosaur.

facts.statement: A partial Acrocanthosaurus-like posterior dorsal vertebra found in the Bissekty Formation in 2024 may belong to Ulughbegsaurus.
facts.quote: A partial Acrocanthosaurus-like posterior dorsal vertebra described in 2024 has also been found in the Bissekty Formation, which could belong to Ulughbegsaurus.

facts.statement: In 2025, Averianov et al. assigned a right maxilla fragment from the early Cenomanian Khodzhakul Formation of Uzbekistan to Ulughbegsaurus sp.
facts.quote: In 2025, Averianov et al. described a right maxilla fragment (specimen ZIN PH 2368/16) from the early Cenomanian Khodzhakul Formation of Uzbekistan as belonging to Ulughbegsaurus sp.

facts.statement: Averianov et al. (2025) revised the estimated size of Ulughbegsaurus to around 7.4 meters based on a new overlapping specimen.
facts.quote: Based on a new specimen that overlapped both the holotype and referred specimen (jugal ramus), Averianov et al. (2025) determined that the total length of the maxilla would have been smaller, slightly reducing the size of Ulughbegsaurus to around 7.4 m.

facts.statement: Ulughbegsaurus is estimated to have had a body length between 7.5 and 8 meters and a weight of more than 1000 kilograms.
facts.quote: Se estima que la longitud corporal deUlughbegsaurus sería de entre 7,5 a 8 metros y tendría un peso de más de 1000 kilogramos.

facts.statement: The lower outer side of the maxilla bone features a series of shallow oval depressions.
facts.quote: A lo largo de la parte inferior del lado exterior del hueso maxilar hay una serie de depresiones ovales poco profundas.

facts.statement: The anterior ramus of the maxilla appears to have a vertical biting edge, unlike the backward-sloping edge typical of carcharodontosaurids.
facts.quote: La rama anterior parece tener un borde de ataque vertical, a diferencia del borde inclinado hacia atrás de los carcarodontosáuridos.

facts.statement: The maxilla shows at least six vertical crests between the second and seventh tooth.
facts.quote: Muestra al menos seis crestas verticales entre el segundo y el séptimo diente.

facts.statement: The teeth of Ulughbegsaurus are notably narrower than those of Timurlengia.
facts.quote: Los dientes son notablemente más estrechos que los de Timurlengia.

facts.statement: Researchers later confirmed that Ulughbegsaurus is a valid carcharodontosaurian taxon after discovering a second comparable maxilla fragment.
facts.quote: However, these authors later commented that the discovery of a second maxilla fragment from older Uzbekistani rocks, comparable to the Ulughbegsaurus holotype and referable to this genus, confirmed that it is a valid carcharodontosaurian taxon.

facts.statement: Based on shared characters with Carcharodontosaurus, Ulughbegsaurus is most likely referred to the family Carcharodontosauridae.
facts.quote: They further argued that, based on characters shared with Carcharodontosaurus, Ulughbegsaurus can most likely be referred to the Carcharodontosauridae.

facts.statement: A 2022 study debated whether Ulughbegsaurus was a nomen dubium lacking diagnostic features and possibly originated from a dromaeosaurid.
facts.quote: A 2022 study suggested that the taxon was a nomen dubium due to lacking diagnostic features, and that it was plausible that the maxilla fragment originated from a dromaeosaurid instead.

facts.statement: Tanaka et al. (2021) used two different phylogenetic datasets to determine the relationships of Ulughbegsaurus.
facts.quote: Tanaka et al. (2021) ran two phylogenetic analyses using two different datasets to determine the relationships of Ulughbegsaurus.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen has a preserved length of 242 millimeters.
facts.quote: El holotipo tiene una longitud conservada de 242 milímetros.

facts.statement: The maxilla bone is triangular in lateral view and touches the nasal fossa.
facts.quote: El hueso maxilar es triangular en vista lateral y toca la fosa nasal.

facts.statement: The inner side of the posterior ramus contribution to the window has pneumatic recesses projecting forward and downward into the bone.
facts.quote: El lado interior de la contribución de la rama posterior a la ventana tiene rebajes neumáticos que se proyectan hacia delante y hacia abajo en el hueso.

facts.statement: The high frontal rampart protruding from the interdental plates has a series of four large vein channels extending along the top.
facts.quote: El terraplén frontal alto que sobresale de las placas interdentales tiene una serie de cuatro grandes canales de venas que se extienden en la parte superior.

facts.statement: The maxilla bone has at least eight teeth.
facts.quote: El hueso maxilar tiene al menos ocho dientes.

facts.statement: Researchers Tanaka et al. performed two phylogenetic analyses using different datasets to determine the relationships of Ulughbegsaurus.
facts.quote: Tanaka et al. llevaron a cabo dos análisis filogenéticos usando dos conjuntos de datos diferentes para determinar las relaciones de Ulughbegsaurus.

facts.statement: One phylogenetic analysis placed Ulughbegsaurus in a polytomy including Neovenator and megaraptorans.
facts.quote: En el primero se situó en una politomía que incluye a Neovenator y a los megaraptoranos

facts.statement: A second analysis placed Ulughbegsaurus in a polytomy with other basal carcharodontosaurids.
facts.quote: mientras que la segunda lo ubica en una politomía que incluye a otros carcarodontosáuridos basales

facts.statement: A 2022 study suggested that Ulughbegsaurus is a nomen dubium due to a lack of diagnostic features.
facts.quote: En un estudio de 2022 sugirió que el taxón era un nomen dubium debido a la falta de características de diagnóstico

facts.statement: Researchers suggested it was plausible that the jaw fragment originated from a dromaeosaurid.
facts.quote: y que era plausible que el fragmento del maxilar se originara en un dromeosáurido

facts.statement: Ulughbegsaurus lived during the Turonian stage, between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Turonian to Turonian (93.9 to 89.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are three recorded fossil occurrences of Ulughbegsaurus.
facts.quote: Fossil occurrences recorded: 3

facts.statement: Ulughbegsaurus coexisted with other carnivorous theropods in the environment of the Bissekty Formation.
facts.quote: Ulughbegsaurus coexistió en el ambiente de la Formación Bissekty con otros terópodos carnívoros

facts.statement: Contemporaneous carnivores included the tyrannosauroid Timurlengia and the dromaeosaurid Itemirus.
facts.quote: entre los que se incluye el tiranosauroideo Timurlengia y el dromeosáurido Itemirus

facts.statement: Due to its size, Ulughbegsaurus may have been the apex predator of its ecosystem.
facts.quote: Debido a su tamaño, puede haber sido el superpredador de su ecosistema

facts.statement: This suggests that carcharodontosaurids remained the dominant carnivorous theropods over tyrannosauroids as late as the Turonian, at least in Asia.
facts.quote: esto muestra que los carcarodontosáuridos eran aún los terópodos carnívoros dominantes, en lugar de los tiranosauroideos, en épocas tan tardías como el Turoniense, al menos en Asia
